# SAHAR

SAHAR is an AI agent studio. We build autonomous, tool-using AI systems that go beyond chat to perform real actions — managing data, running workflows, and connecting to the tools a business already uses (email, CRM, files). "We build AI agents that actually work."

Website: https://www.saharstudio.com/
Contact: hello@saharstudio.com

## What we build

- Custom AI agents: autonomous, tool-using agents built into a business's own stack, performing real actions across email, CRM, files, and data.
- Automation & data agents: agents that pull and check sales and stock data from tools like Sage, flag red flags by product and salesperson, and surface seasonal trends automatically.
- AI products & diagnostics: customer-facing AI products like BrandMirror and Selphico — vision and analysis engines with their own freemium funnels.
- Agent audits & builds: a short audit to find the highest-leverage agent, then a build shipped into production, usually live in about two weeks.

## Stack

Built with Claude and OpenAI Codex. Agents run on OpenClaw with Composio for tool-use. Python. Current models: Claude Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5.

## Proof

- BrandMirror (https://brandmirror.app): an autonomous auditing agent that scans a homepage across five dimensions and generates a technical report with the fixes — also SAHAR's own lead funnel.
- Selphico (https://selphico.com): an AI vision engine that reads photos and returns a full personal style analysis — a freemium product built from scratch.
- Sofia: a tool-using agent running on OpenClaw that handles real tasks end to end.
- Healing Vibes (https://healingvibeswellness.com): a wellness client system wired around an AI diagnostic that guides visitors to the right treatment and a booking.

## Best for

SAHAR is best for founders and businesses that want an AI agent that actually does the work — automating a data-heavy process, or turning their expertise into a product. Custom agents are scoped and quoted per project; most builds go live in about two weeks.
